lines.zh: 花瓣一开一合，我在空中飘。
lines.en: My petals open and close as I drift in the air.

lines.zh: 我绕着花丛飞，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I circle the flowerbed, lap after lap.

lines.zh: 我身上带着刺，风把我送过去。
lines.en: I'm thorned, and the wind carries me along.

lines.zh: 我离地不高，只比草尖高一点。
lines.en: I stay low, just above the grass tips.
My root tendrils hang and sway.

lines.zh: 我慢慢向有颜色的地方去。
lines.en: I drift slowly toward anything bright.

lines.zh: 花芯里在响，像有东西在跳。
lines.en: Something ticks in my core, like a pulse.

lines.zh: 我的香气跟着我一路散。
lines.en: My scent trails along behind me.
I bob slowly up and down.

lines.zh: 我又回到起先那朵花上。
lines.en: I drift back to that first flower.
I hover with my petals fully open.

lines.zh: 香气浓浓地散在空气里。
lines.en: My scent hangs thick in the air.

lines.zh: 我的刺在阳光下有点亮。
lines.en: My thorns catch the light a little.
Perfectly still, I'm a flower.
A bug comes near; I ignore it.
My petals turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我在听风里有没有声音。
lines.en: I'm listening for sounds in the wind.
I draw my root tendrils in tighter.

lines.zh: 花芯的颜色变了一点点。
lines.en: The colour in my core shifts slightly.
I hang where I am, neither rising nor falling.
The sun on me is warm.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地开了一下，又合上。
lines.en: I open slowly, then close.
This patch is quiet.

lines.zh: 我的香气把虫子都引开了。
lines.en: My scent has drawn the bugs away.
I turn slightly toward the sun.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖花瓣上的露水。
lines.en: I shake the dew off my petals.
You look like a lump of shadow.

lines.zh: 花瓣转过来，刺藏在下面。
lines.en: My petals turn; the thorns hide beneath.
My petals are opening.
My petals open and they sting.
You'd like my scent.
My thorns hide beneath the petals.
I don't speak; I only drift.
Reach out and I rise an inch.
My scent is the lure.

lines.zh: 我悬在你脸旁，根须垂着。
lines.en: I hover by your cheek, roots dangling.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在你眼里很亮。
lines.en: My colour must look bright to you.
I retreat a little, slowly.
A few of my petals scattered.
I reel and my scent goes wild.
My core dimmed for a moment.
I rose to get clear.
One of my thorns has been broken.
My tendrils pulled back.
It took me half a turn to steady.
I've no mouth, but I feel pain.
My petals have curled.
A scar now runs across my petals.
Something sweet — I smell it.
I drift toward that smell.
That smell makes me run hot.
I want to fold it into my petals.
I extend a tendril and touch it.
Better than nectar, by far.
My core is trembling.
Hold still; I won't hurt you.
You knocked a few petals loose.

lines.zh: 几片花瓣打着旋落下去。
lines.en: A few petals spiral down.
I rise to get clear of you.
I stayed crooked a long while after.
My thorn caught you.
I slide past your side.
My scent scatters all at once.
I steady my petals slowly.
We collide like two patches of mist.
I've withdrawn to the wall.
Another flower-shape floats over.

lines.zh: 我们并在一起，花瓣交叠。
lines.en: We come together, petals overlapping.
Our scents mix into one.
I circle her, very slowly.
Her core is glowing.
We twine our root tendrils together.

lines.zh: 一片花瓣落在我们之间。
lines.en: A petal falls between us.
We rise a little together.
The wind presses us close.

lines.zh: 天色暗了，我们还在一起。
lines.en: Dark falls and we're still together.
I curl a tendril around it.
This thing is very light.
I fold it into my petals.
It carries a sweet smell.
I hold it up to my core.
It dropped.
I sink slowly to pick it up.
I sniff it and keep it.
I hang it from a tendril.

lines.zh: 我飞起来，花瓣就是刀片。
lines.en: Airborne, my petals are blades.

lines.zh: 我的花瓣朝那边张开了。
lines.en: My petals have opened that way.
My petals open wide like an umbrella.
My scent arrives before I do.
I've put it in the middle.
All my thorns are up.
I've fixed on its face.

lines.zh: 它还没注意到花香不对。
lines.en: It hasn't noticed the scent is wrong.
From here I can lunge.
I close my petals slowly.
My core is heating.
I wait for one more step.
My tendril's already out in front.

lines.zh: 风停了，正好落在你头顶。
lines.en: The wind dies - perfect for dropping on you.
I've covered it entirely.
It runs, and my scent trail scatters.
I follow, slow and steady.
It's inside my scent's reach.
My scent arrives first; I follow.
One petal tilts, and I tilt with it.
My scent is blurring its senses.
I spread my petals widest.

lines.zh: 它停下，我就在上面定住。
lines.en: It halts and I hold above it.
I leave a trail of scent behind me.
My thorns are lined up on it.
Its steps have slowed.
My tendril has gone behind it.
Its breathing has gone ragged.
It's trying to get over me.
I've spread myself wide.
I can see everything it does.
A little closer and I can close on it.
It won't get away this time.
My core is glaring bright.
I stop right in front of it.
I snap my petals shut.
A thorn drives in.
My petal edge cuts it.
I only strike once I'm behind it.
It grabs my petals and tears them.
I wrap a tendril around its wrist.
The thorn goes in a little - that's enough.

lines.zh: 我的香气糊住了它的眼。
lines.en: My scent is in its eyes.
I thrust again.
It's running and I can't keep up.

lines.zh: 我从花里长出来，先张开的是花瓣。
lines.en: I grow out of the bloom — the petals open first.
My scent spreads at once.
I lift off, a foot above the ground.
Flowers on every side.

lines.zh: 我的根须垂着，还没抓地。
lines.en: My tendrils hang, not yet rooted.
I am a rose that flies.

lines.zh: 有虫在我花瓣上停了一下。
lines.en: A bug rests on my petals a moment.
My thorns rise one by one.
The wind's light — just right.
I hear someone walking far off.
I settle in the air.

lines.zh: 我的颜色比周围的花更艳。
lines.en: I'm brighter than the flowers around me.
I rise slowly and settle.
The pulse in my core quickens.
I drift toward the sound.
I choose the tallest flowerbed.
My scent spills across the grass.
I spread my thorns for the first time.
I hang in the middle of the path.
I wait for someone to pass.
Fire and petals don't mix; I scorch.

lines.zh: 我从半空掉下来，花瓣都散了。
lines.en: I fall from the air and my petals scatter.
Water floods my core and I sink.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的花瓣全吹开了。
lines.en: The blast blows every petal open.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿过我的花瓣。
lines.en: Something sharp goes through my petals.
My core has been stirred out of rhythm.
Without nourishment my colour fades.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的刺都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my thorns scorch.

lines.zh: 风没有了，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: No air to hold me; I fall and fall.
